name: pricing-card
title: Pricing cards
description: Two or three plan cards that rise in side by side, each with its name, price and a ticked feature list; then the featured plan lifts forward with an accent border and badge while the others dim. Plans are a JSON list of {"name", "price", "features": [...]}; Featured counts from 1 (0 for none). Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Ink to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Plans (JSON list of {name, price, features})
